results.title: `note_revocation` with a `warrant_id`
results.evidence: `note_revocation` accepts a `warrant_id`, and the id moves: two resolutions of one grant minted 01a0a27c618aeb7e… and 01a0a27c618b5977…, so an id noted from one never matches the one `execute` checks and the floor cannot fire. An engine told to stop by descriptor id holds a local revocation list that looks enabled and does nothing — the model URN is the form that works, and both are accepted with
